jobs.prompt: Empty fifth-floor Warsaw law office at night. Dark wood desk, leather chair, full bookshelves with blank spines, banker's lamp drawn in grey ink. A blank smartphone lies glass-up. A plain paper envelope with a smooth flap. Through the south window, across a square, the stepped stone tower and needle spire of the Palace of Culture, crown as a flat masonry band, no clock face. Rain on the outside of the glass. The room is dry. Wide panel, subject in the center.

First-person ink comic, two bare lawyer hands only, white shirt cuffs, dark suit sleeves, five ordinary fingers, no marks on the skin. A blank grey smartphone faces the camera. An iPad in a keyboard folio, blank grey screen. A string-tied grey folder of blank paper. The same south window and Palace of Culture needle, flat masonry crown, no clock face. Rain on the outside of the glass. No face. The building outside is grey ink, not red.

Wide ink comic of Filip, a Polish man in his early twenties, round thin wire glasses, messy dark hair, freckles, white shirt, dark tie, anxious eyes, skin in grey ink. Two ordinary hands with five fingers, no symbols on the skin. He holds an older smartphone, glass facing him, blank grey screen. He stands in a small modern office. The east window shows a wet avenue and tram wires, no palace, no spire. Subject in the center.

Wide ink comic of a middle-aged Polish partner, receding dark hair, heavy brow, overcoat, white shirt, dark tie, stern eyes, skin in grey ink. He sits at a wood desk with an older smartphone at his ear and a plain laptop lid in front of him. Blank paper on the desk. The west window shows a wavy glass roof and a long station roof, no palace, no spire, no clock. Subject in the center.

Wide ink comic of Irena, a woman about forty, hair in a tight bun, rectangular glasses with no chain, dark blouse, calm face, skin in grey ink. She stands at a reception counter, one hand on an open paper desk calendar with a blank grid, a pencil with a rubber eraser, a grey-ink banker's lamp. Her phone glass is dim grey. A closed wood door with a blank nameplate is behind her. No window, no skyline, no envelope lettering. Subject in the center.

Comic desk still-life: three unmarked manila folders of blank paper, no seals, an older smartphone with a blank grey screen, a closed laptop, a grey-ink banker's lamp, blinds. Through the window the Palace of Culture needle and a flat masonry crown, no clock face. Rain on the outside of the glass. The desk is dry.
